subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with a suitable word of your own based on the information in the text. 0.
stimulus: India is our (a)___ neighbour. New Delhi is the (b)___ of India and about 13 (c)___ people live in the (d)___. India is a (e)___ of ancient (f)___. The (g)___ of India is one of the (h)___ and unique in the (i)___. There is amazing cultural (j)___ throughout the country.
guide_solution: (a) closest; (b) capital; (c) million; (d) capital; (e) land; (f) civilization; (g) culture; (h) oldest; (i) world; (j) diversity.
